I am a week late on releasing the story, and for that I have to first apologize to everyone, I'm sorry. I made a lot of characters for this story, around 20 characters and outfits! That took me around two weeks of work, I made all of these characters so when I have to do the next parts, I won't have to make any! Hope that pays off in the future. And then, this last week, I kept having power outages and then I got a nasty cold that gave me a fever, so it all added up. Anyway, enough excuses, here is the preview of the story.

So, the synopsis of this story! Everyone knows Cybal and how prideful and cocky she is, but you have never seen her like this, or rather you've never seen how she was before she was turned into Cybal. Her name was Sibyl, she's a police officer inside Eridia! What's Eridia you ask? That's a virtual world that everyone visits to meet up with friend and family. Everything is going well, Sibyl catches thieves and other evil-doers, she enjoys her everyday life, that is until a new and enhanced visor is about to be released, and Sibyl isn't too sure this new visor is good for everyone...
